corpus_scope: Stage 002 Kentucky homeowners — 28 sources including KNIC and KFBM SERFF filings, KRS statutes, KAR regulations, and DOI bulletins (repaired run 18b0dec5)
purpose: Retrieval evaluation gold set. Each item has expected_node_id, test_queries, and expected retrieval modes. Used by evaluator.py to measure phrase, BM25, and semantic recall, false positives, and missed hits.
notes: eval-001 through eval-021 use document-vocabulary queries (phrase/BM25 matchable). eval-022 through eval-026 are Smell 5 paraphrase items added 2026-06-04 using reviewer-perspective plain-language queries; expected_retrieval_modes is [semantic] to test whether embeddings surface nodes that BM25 misses. Run 996e36af was the original reference run; repaired expanded run 18b0dec5 revalidated BM25 at 21/21 on 2026-06-04.

items.smell_name: Calculation Rule Drift / Unversioned Rate Reference
items.fixture_summary: GENERAL RULES section header — top of the rate manual; test whether parser surfaces the section boundary as a retrievable node
Replacement Cost Coverage: flat premium charge cited without defining replacement cost or linking to an appraisal standard
406 Additional Amounts: '80% or more' coinsurance threshold — magic number with no actuarial basis cited in the text
Insurance to Value: 'statistics provided by a national appraisal company' — undefined external data source driving policy adjustment, no filing anchor

items.smell_name: Calculation Rule Drift / Unversioned Rate Reference
items.fixture_summary: Special State Requirements: mandates specific endorsements by form number without citing an edition date or version anchor — references filed forms by ID without tying to a dated filing
Sinkhole Collapse endorsement: 'may be endorsed to provide' — optional coverage language with undefined scope and no mandatory disclosure; smell 1 overbroad exclusion pattern
Limited Fungi endorsement: coverage grant qualified by 'limited' with no defined scope — coverage inversion via restrictive qualifier that narrows apparent coverage without enumerated limits
Earthquake Coverage endorsement: optional add-on with its own deductible structure — smell 3 pattern where optional endorsement creates coverage inversion relative to base policy

Special State Requirements mandates specific endorsements on all policies without citing which law or regulation requires them — paraphrase query tests semantic retrieval for regulatory-obligation-without-citation pattern
test_queries: Does this policy tell me which specific law or regulation requires this provision?
items.notes: Same node as eval-018 (Smell 4, document-vocabulary queries). This item tests the same node with a reviewer-perspective paraphrase query to evaluate semantic recall.

items.fixture_summary: Manual Premium Revision: 'revision shall be made in accordance with...as announced' — no SERFF filing number or effective date anchor; paraphrase query tests semantic retrieval for unanchored rate-rule reference

items.fixture_summary: Changes or Cancellations asserts 'mandatory coverages' as a cancellation constraint without citing which KRS provision establishes them as mandatory — paraphrase query tests semantic retrieval for implied statutory obligation

items.fixture_summary: KFBM roof surfacing ACV endorsement limits replacement cost to ACV for windstorm/hail losses without citing the regulatory authority that permits this coverage limitation — paraphrase query tests semantic retrieval for permission-without-citation pattern
test_queries: Does this endorsement explain what regulatory authority permits it to limit coverage this way?

items.fixture_summary: KFBM Inflation Guard references 'an index of construction costs' as the basis for annual limit increases without naming the index or citing the filed rule that governs the percentage — paraphrase query tests semantic retrieval for unanchored rating rule
test_queries: Is there a traceable link between this policy condition and a filed, approved rule?
